data.one_liner: Generate Android notification icons from a source image
data.what_it_does: This package creates the required Android notification icon assets in the correct density folders. It runs as a Dart CLI tool and writes the resized PNGs into the Android project structure.
use_when: You need custom notification icons for an Android Flutter app
You want a quick, automated way to generate all density variants
avoid_when: You are targeting only iOS or web
You already use a comprehensive icon generator that covers notification icons
strengths: No build_runner or code generation required
Creates all required density folders automatically
weaknesses: No support for iOS or other platforms

alternatives.name: flutter_launcher_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: Generates app launcher icons for multiple platforms, but not notification icons

data.minimal_example:
```yaml
# pubspec.yaml
dev_dependencies:
  android_notification_icons:

android_notification_icons:
  image_path: 'assets/ic_notification.png'
  icon_name: 'ic_notification'
```
```bash
dart run android_notification_icons
```
